subject: SIG submission: last-mile checklist & blocked items
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@clearpath.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearpath.io
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG completion target — need status and final evidence by 11/20

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for your time earlier this week. Legal and InfoSec at ClearPath have set a hard deadline: they need the completed SIG questionnaire and supporting evidence by Friday 11/20 COB PST.

Can you confirm what remains outstanding, and whether Redwood can provide the evidence matrix and suggested answers by Wednesday so we have time to review before the deadline? If there are any gating items (procurement, privileged access for validation, or SOC 2 snapshots), please call out timelines.

Attached: SIG-questions.csv (they included the vendor SIG).

Appreciate a short summary and an ETA so we can adjust our review plan.

-jared

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@clearpath.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: SIG completion target — need status and final evidence by 11/20

Jared —

Thanks, we have visibility on the deadline. Quick summary of what is outstanding:

- SIG answers: ~85% complete. Remaining ~25 questions are nuanced (data residency, subprocessor list, crypto key handling, retention policies).
- Evidence: we can assemble the evidence-matrix PDF but need clarity on whether ClearPath needs SOC 2 test logs (read-only) or attested excerpts.
- Internal reviewers: Diego will own technical evidence pulls (audit logs, KV cache retention config), Marissa will own process docs and policy PDFs.

Plan:
- By Tue 11/17 EOD PST: draft answers for all questions; flag 10-12 items requiring legal/technical confirmation.
- By Wed 11/18 EOD PST: consolidated evidence matrix (PDF) with stubbed links to artifacts.
- By Thu 11/19: internal review and sign-off; mock delivery to ClearPath for early feedback.
- Fri 11/20 COB: final submission.

If ClearPath needs SOC 2 artifact extracts (not the full report), we can provide limited excerpts under NDA by Thu.

Kimberly
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (we reference the CSV Jared sent).
